kcat_table_verification.kcat_notes: Open Enzyme Database first (1126 organism rows, substrate-matched against 3710 units), then the EC homolog tier (35753 rows, any organism), then predicted tier = median over ezkinetics, eitlem, unikp (verified tables, admitted by own_class_band against the EC-median lookup at 0.532), then the median of the 879 database-tier values, 9.6 1/s. A complex takes the min over its subunits.

wave7.name: betaxanthin parity, wave 7, every flux cell on the shipped verified kcat table
wave7.scoring_rule: pinned Merzbacher test Spearman at the epoch selected by the centered 5-epoch moving average of validation Pearson; never a maximum over epochs.

combined.name: betaxanthin parity, every pair on the shipped verified kcat table
combined.scoring_rule: pinned Merzbacher test Spearman at the epoch selected by the centered 5-epoch moving average of validation Pearson; never a maximum over epochs.
combined.note: wave 7 plus every wave-6 pair whose flux cell also carries the shipped table. Wave-6 pairs on the shipped table: none. The wave-6 'same table' subset (seeds 2700, 2701, 2703) is the WAVE-5 table 148/0/3410/170, not the shipped one, so it cannot be pooled with wave 7.

combined_with_wave6_same_table_group.name: betaxanthin parity, wave 7 pooled with the largest wave-6 same-table group (TWO tables, not one)
combined_with_wave6_same_table_group.scoring_rule: pinned Merzbacher test Spearman at the epoch selected by the centered 5-epoch moving average of validation Pearson; never a maximum over epochs.
combined_with_wave6_same_table_group.note: wave 7 seeds are on the shipped verified table (97/782/2831/18); the wave-6 seeds pooled in here are on default=170/measured=148/predicted=3410. Reported because the six-seed combination was asked for, and labeled because the two halves are not replicates of one another.
